C1531.title: Coinbase Issues Warning on Quantum Computing Threat
C1531.summary: Coinbase warned that quantum computers could threaten the security of approximately 7 million bitcoins. The alert came amid a market panic index nearing 10 and Bitcoin falling below $60,000, highlighting the potential systemic risk quantum computing poses to existing blockchain encryption systems.
